brief:
Israeli tanks opened fire in Rafah and Deir al-Balah in southern Gaza, the Ma'an news agency reported. The military operations struck both urban areas in the Strip's southernmost regions, where displaced Palestinians have sought shelter in recent months.

Israeli warships conducted separate strikes against fishing vessels operating in Gaza's coastal waters. The targeting of fishing boats has persisted throughout the conflict, affecting the territory's already devastated fishing industry and limiting residents' access to maritime food sources. The combined ground and naval operations underscore the scope of Israeli military activity across Gaza's southern and coastal zones.
title: Israeli tanks fire in Rafah and Deir al-Balah; warships target fishing boats
